'''Ace Fendo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] chassis dealer who conducted business at the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROTW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ace Fendo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, his name could briefly appear as "Ace Fendo (a chassis broker)," before changing to simply "Chassis Dealer."<ref name="ROTW" /> The game files confirm his full designation as "Ace Fendo (a chassis broker)."<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|game files}}</ref>
